title: Evaluating Antibiotic Course Upon Adequate Treatment of Empyema
official: EvACUATE Trial, Evaluating Antibiotic Course Upon Adequate Treatment of Empyema
summary: The study compares treatment strategies for treatment of pleural empyema (infected fluid in the chest). It will compare standard of care antibiotic course, 2-6 weeks, to a shorter course of antibiotics, 7 days. This course is started once patients achieve adequate source control/drainage of the infected fluid collection. All other treatments and interventions in patients such as blood work, imaging, vitals, and surgery/procedures follows current standard of care and are not experimental.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adults with pleural empyema

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects must not be, younger than 18 or older than 99 years of age, have ongoing evidence of fungal infection, tuberculosis, malignant effusions or cancer involving the lungs/pleura, pregnancy, immunocompromised patients, \& patients with concurrent secondary infections requiring additional antibiotic therapy
